title: Cheaper to buy separate?
text:
First shipment was great, received an album that I both wanted and saved a few bucks from being a Club member. The second shipment was not as friendly -- could've purchased the album substantially cheaper on Amazon.

The Vinyl of the Month Club can be great -- but, if they are going to send albums that they are selling at LOWER PRICE at the higher club price, this is NOT WORTH IT.
label: negative
